LanguageData.PhobosProwlerPatches_SettingRealisticHan: Off by default. On: the Prowler flies at speeds set by the real EA-6B's, against the Harrier's. Today the Prowler's author already gives it the real jet's top speed with its jammer pods and its real cruising speed, so this changes nothing yet; it holds those figures if a later update of his changes them. Its take-offs, landings, turns and jamming orbit are never changed.
LanguageData.PhobosProwlerPatches_NeedsRestart: Changing this takes effect when the game next starts.
